steps.label: dbt CI
steps.sub: build + test against a disposable per-PR Snowflake schema

steps.label: Branch protection
steps.sub: both checks required before merge to main

code:
dbt_ci:
  run: dbt build --target ci --fail-fast
  run: dbt test --target ci
  schema: CI_PR_${{ pull_request.number }}
caption: Runs in its own disposable schema -- never RAW or CURATED.

code:
terraform_ci:
  run: terraform fmt -check -recursive
  run: terraform validate
  run: terraform plan -input=false
caption: Plan only. Apply stays a deliberate, human-run step outside CI.

subtitle: Watching the pipeline keep running, not just keep passing tests.
